anomalies: Figure/label counts match exactly in both tiers (19/19 outer, 10/10 inner): no unlabeled nymphs, no shared labels.

Locus 33 (otylal) labels a STAR in the central zone, not a nymph; central zone also holds the two Pisces fish, ~2 unlabeled stars, and the month word 'mars' in a later non-Voynichese hand under the upper fish.

Takahashi locus numbering wraps: outer sequence runs 5..20,2,3,4 and inner 23..31,22, but each is a single consistent clockwise rotation - the low-numbered loci sit just CCW of the tier's first transcribed label. No anchor contradicts the single-rotation model.
Labels are written consistently to the clockwise (right) side of each figure's star; this convention held for all 29 nymph loci and drove binding.

All 29 nymphs are nude (bare bust); clothing_color empty throughout. All 19 outer nymphs stand in upright patterned barrels (each barrel pattern distinct: stripes, scales, bricks, coins, chevrons, dots); inner-tier barrels are green-dotted and lie sideways on the parapet ring, with 7 of 10 inner figures touching one; loci 24, 27, 22 have no container contact.
Two outer nymphs (locus 2 at ~9:36 and locus 4 at ~10:48) additionally hold small dark triangular objects (pouch/jug-like) - the only object-holders besides stars/veil on the folio.
Locus 26 label reads simply 'dolaram' on pixels; Takahashi's trailing run of 14 '!' has no visible glyph counterpart, only the star-cord line continuing through the space.
Locus 3 reads okady rather than okasy at pixel level (s/d ambiguous); loci 23/24 labels are near-identical (otaral/otalar) and were assigned by rotational order; graded med accordingly.
Vertical fold creases distort the 7-8 o'clock inner band (locus 30 label partly obscured) and the 12 o'clock outer region; outer band spacing is sparse between 3 and 5 o'clock.
Inner-tier stars are held on long cords (star_tail=yes recorded where cord/tail visible); outer-tier stars mostly float free beside the raised hand, a few with comet-like tails.

anomalies: Census matches exactly: 10 outer figures / 10 outer labels, 5 inner / 5 inner. No unlabeled or extra figures, no shared labels.

Label placement convention on this folio: each label is written at the tip of the STAR its figure holds, not above the head. Because arms extend toward the clockwise neighbor, every label physically sits between its figure and the next CW figure, creating a systematic one-position binding hazard. Resolved by exact-read anchors okldam (11:00, at the standing figure's star), chsary (6:00), otol.chdy (inner 11:00), otal.dar (inner 8:30).

Three circumtext rings confirmed and excluded from binding: locus 1 outer ring (words okeodar, okeoky, oteody, oto, otol, oteey, ar, oto!keoar read in situ in matching sequence), locus 12 middle ring (okal!ody, lsheotey, oteodal read in situ), locus 18 inner ring (okeeody read in situ). This corroborates the tasklist's label/ring separation.
Outer figures are evenly spaced (~36 deg); integer clock rounding leaves apparent empty slots at 4 and 8 o'clock - not real gaps.
Locus 3 (okldam) binds to the only outer figure WITHOUT a container: a standing full-length nymph at 11:00; all other outer figures are half-length in barrels/tubs.
At 3 o'clock BOTH tiers have figures drawn head-inward (hanging toward center), unlike the rest of the ring - a local layout quirk.
Latin-script month inscription 'abril' (later hand, dark ink) under the Aries ram in the central medallion.

Weakest bindings: locus 8 otalsar (faint word at 4:40 figure's star; partly by closed-set elimination) and locus 10 oteo!tey.sary (two short words at 7:00 star consistent with tey+sary but oteo- portion unresolved). Neither contradicts the clockwise alignment.
star_hand and facing are recorded from the radially-upright (rotation-corrected) view of each figure; for inverted/slanted figures (3:00, 4:40, 7:00 outer; 3:00 inner) these are approximate.
No tailed stars observed anywhere on the folio; all 15 stars are plain 6-8 point stars, one per figure, each touched or held by an extended hand.

anomalies: OUTER COUNT MISMATCH: 16 figures but 15 labels. The unlabeled figure is a CLOTHED figure with turban-like headdress at ~253deg (clock 8), holding a star, standing between the orary figure (~236deg) and the okyd figure (~268deg). Checked radius 500-880 around it: no label present. All other outer figures pair 1:1 with labels under the consistent convention that a label sits 4-11deg clockwise of its figure.

Outer-band figures from ~200deg to ~253deg (loci 17, 18, 19 + the unlabeled figure) are CLOTHED (tunics, pleated skirts, one dotted belted dress, coifs/turban) and stand on pedestal objects (mound with barrel-lid disc, block with wheel-like ring, scroll-shaped base); all other outer figures are nude and stand free. Clothing is unpainted ink (no color wash on any band figure; only the central couple is painted green/blue).
No tubs/barrels containing figures on this folio; the barrel-like objects are under feet (pedestals). Container field is 'none' throughout.
Locus 16 (okeal) stands on a furry double-lobed tussock/pouch object.

Several referents lack their own star: locus 14 (otair.dy, hands at waist), locus 19 (orary), locus 20 (okyd, holds small unidentified object). Locus 26 (otalshy) has only a small gold blob not in hand.

A vertical fold crease (foldout panel boundary) passes through the 2-4 o'clock outer region near loci 12-13; text of the adjacent foldout panel is visible beyond the right fold and was excluded.

Legibility limit: this is a low-resolution scan; gallows k vs t are frequently indistinguishable, so 4-glyph labels okal/otal/okam/otam were discriminated partly by sequence position (graded med, read_match partial). Exact reads were only claimed where a distinctive skeleton (dy/ldy endings, ee clusters, ch/s/a initials, gallows-free orary, two-word labels) was visible in pixels.
Tier start points: outer transcription starts at ~10 o'clock (locus 7), inner at ~10 o'clock (locus 23), both proceed clockwise with zero order contradictions across 20 read anchors.
Inner band spacing is uneven (gaps of ~30-55deg) but count matches labels exactly (9/9).
